answer: Work waits on the zenith until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the river of the next round. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
